archetypes.name: dyn-main-health
archetypes.rationale: New skip routing touches main-health classification, wait, and ship gates.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed main-health path for overly broad skip classification. Confirm only the configured default workflow missing from gh run list maps to skip, while auth, network, malformed JSON, empty run lists, custom missing workflows, and red runs remain fail-closed. Inspect the tests for coverage of raw CommandResult handling and terminal skip routing in preflight and ship phases. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
